name: @mesh/wallpaper-directory
description: Wallpaper library from one directory, with cached thumbnails and average colours made by ImageMagick.

optionalCapabilities: exec.argv:sh:["-c","f=\"$1\"; t=\"${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/mesh/wallpaper-thumbs\"; mkdir -p \"$t\" || exit 1; k=\"$(printf %s \"$f\" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)-$(stat -c %Y \"$f\")\"; [ -f \"$t/$k.jpg\" ] || magick \"$f[0]\" -thumbnail 640x400^ -gravity center -extent 640x400 -quality 82 \"$t/$k.jpg\" || exit 1; [ -f \"$t/$k.color\" ] || magick \"$t/$k.jpg\" -resize 1x1! -format '%[hex:p{0,0}]' info: > \"$t/$k.color\"; printf '%s\\t%s' \"$t/$k.jpg\" \"$(cut -c1-6 \"$t/$k.color\")\"","sh","*"]

binaries.name: magick
binaries.reason: Make small previews and average colours of wallpapers.

directory.description: Directory of wallpaper images; ~ is your home.
